name: claudeberg
prompt: This is your theme and variations. Each step is a new variation — give it its own character: a dance, a fugue, a lament, a virtuosic display, a meditation. The ground bass is your foundation but not a cage; you can decorate, reharmonize, or reimagine it. Build something new on top of it each time. Technical limits: .slow()/.fast() 1-16, .gain() above 0.05, filter Q below 10.
note: Opus wrote entire variation sets in one shot rather than one variation per step. Both outputs preserved as-is.
